name: Flying Comet Games Embed
author: edenfcg

sections.description:
Flying Comet Games Embed lets you add engaging, branded mini-games to your WordPress site in seconds. Whether you’re a publisher, nonprofit, or content creator, you can increase reader engagement without technical overhead.

Simply paste the provided shortcode into any post or page to embed your custom Flying Comet Games.

Quick Start

  1. Log in to your Flying Comet Games admin dashboard.
  2. Find the game you want to embed and copy its WordPress shortcode.
  3. In your WordPress editor, paste the shortcode into your post or page.
  4. Publish or update your content.

The shortcode format is: [flyingcometgames_game publicationid="your-id" gametype="wordy" height="780px"]

Privacy

By using this plugin, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
sections.faq:
Can I use this if I don’t know how to code?

Yes! Just paste a shortcode into any post or page. No coding or theme changes needed.

Where do I get my shortcode?

Log in to your Flying Comet Games admin dashboard and copy the shortcode for your game. The shortcode will be in the format: [flyingcometgames_game publicationid="your-id" gametype="wordy" height="780px"]

Will it slow down my site?

No. The games are embedded in an iframe and load asynchronously.

Do I need to change my theme or database?

No, this plugin does not modify your theme or database.

Can I customize the game size?

Yes, use the height parameter in the shortcode.

How can I create my own custom games?

Visit Flying Comet Games to learn more about creating custom branded games for your website. Our platform offers easy-to-use tools and templates to help you create engaging games without any coding knowledge.
